title: Bounded normalized integral for complete scalars on pro-prime-to-ell groups
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a complete nonarchimedean normed field $B$ containing $\mathbf Q_\ell$ isometrically [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]; thus $|x+y|\leq\max(|x|,|y|)$ and every Cauchy sequence converges in $B$. Let $K$ be a profinite group (a compact Hausdorff topological group with a basis of open normal subgroups), all of whose finite continuous quotient groups have order prime to $\ell$. Write $C(P,B)$ for all continuous maps from a profinite space $P$ to $B$, and give $C(K,B)$ the supremum norm. There exists a $B$-linear map
$$I_K:C(K,B)\longrightarrow B$$
with $|I_K(f)|\leq\sup_{h\in K}|f(h)|$, $I_K(1)=1$, and $I_K(h\mapsto f(ah))=I_K(f)=I_K(h\mapsto f(ha))$ for all $a\in K$. For every open normal $U\subseteq K$ and every function $f$ factoring through $Q=K/U$,
$$I_K(f)=|Q|^{-1}\sum_{q\in Q}f(q).$$
For every profinite space $P$ and every $f\in C(P\times K,B)$, the function $p\mapsto I_K(h\mapsto f(p,h))$ is continuous. This operation is $C(P,B)$-linear and commutes with precomposition by every continuous map $P'\to P$. It also commutes with finite sums. All spaces lie in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention].

proof.text: Equip B locally with the Padic ell algebra induced by iota. Its scalar norm bound follows from multiplicativity of the norm and the isometry of iota. Apply [lem-sfb-finite-quotient-contractive-average] with the given ultrametric inequality, basis and prime-to-ell hypotheses. Obtain the submodule D, its exact quotient-factorization characterization, constants, and a contractive normalized B-linear average A invariant under both translations. Retain quotient finiteness to identify the finite sum with the topological sum in the conclusion.

proof.text: The dense set in [lem-sfb-quotient-functions-dense] is D by its characterization in step 1, so the submodule inclusion has dense range. Apply LinearMap.extendOfNorm from [lem-sfb-dense-subspace-contractive-extension] to A and this inclusion with constant C=1. Its agreement and norm-bound lemmas give a continuous B-linear contraction I extending A. Agreement on the unit gives normalization; agreement on any quotient function gives its average formula. For each finite quotient, finsum and tsum both equal the sum over all quotient elements.

proof.text: Fix a in K. ContinuousMap.compCLM bundles precomposition with each continuous left or right translation as a continuous B-linear map on C(K,B). On each d in D, [lem-sfb-finite-quotient-contractive-average] supplies translated elements of D with unchanged average. Pointwise extensionality identifies their underlying functions with the two precompositions. Agreement of I with A therefore shows that I composed with either translation equals I on D. The dense-range equalizer principle, equivalently uniqueness of continuous extension in [lem-sfb-dense-subspace-contractive-extension], gives equality on all C(K,B).

proof.text: Use [lem-sfb-compact-parameter-functional] with $X=K$ and $L=I_K$. A group is nonempty, and compactness and Hausdorffness are hypotheses, so this applies to every profinite $P$. It gives the continuous function $J_P(f)(p)=I_K(f(p,-))$, its $C(P,B)$-linearity, every finite-sum identity including the empty sum, and naturality under each continuous $P'\to P$. These are precisely all remaining clauses. The empty parameter spaces are included. All objects use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention].
